liz: Heads up — mkdocs build failing after we moved /examples into /content/examples. Local dev site serves fine but CI fails with:
```
ERROR: IncludeFileNotFoundError: examples/setup.md not found
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/markdown_include/__init__.py", line 42, in include_file
```
Can someone take a look? @sam @kevin

-docs-ci-bot: Build #582 — docs pipeline failed on `mkdocs build`. Logs attached: https://ci.internal/reports/582

sam: Most likely the `include` plugin base path needs updating (we moved the docs_dir). Try setting `docs_dir: "content"` in mkdocs.yml or configure the include plugin base path.

kevin: I can patch it. Quick approach: update mkdocs.yml + run a repo-wide replace for `](examples/` links that assume docs root. Example quick patch:
```
# branch
git checkout -b docs/examples-pathfix
# replace hrefs in markdown
git grep -l "(examples/" docs | xargs sed -i "s/(examples\//(\/examples\//g"
```
I'll open a PR and run linkcheck.

sam: Note—absolute leading slash will break `mkdocs serve` for some setups. Better to configure the include plugin's `base_path` to `content` and avoid changing links if possible. Also add `link-checker` to CI for this repo.

liz: OK let's do plugin config + linkcheck. kevin can you open the PR and include CI linkcheck job? Assign to me for review.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1289 — changes: set `docs_dir: content`, configure `markdown-include` base path, add `make linkcheck` CI step. CI passed except one broken image reference I couldn't auto-fix.

-docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck report (PR 1289):
- ERROR 404: /content/examples/assets/logo.png referenced from content/examples/getting-started.md

sam: That image path is inlined in an include — I'll push a follow-up to move the asset under `content/examples/assets` and update the include path.

liz: Great. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
